statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (username TEXT PRIMARY KEY, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('admin','user')), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shares (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_username TEXT NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL, recipient_email TEXT NOT NULL, permission TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(permission IN ('read','read-write')), token_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_used_at DATETIME, expires_at DATETIME, FOREIGN KEY (owner_username) REFERENCES users(username) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shares_token ON shares(token_hash)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shares_owner ON shares(owner_username)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shares_recipient ON shares(recipient_email)

migrations.description: drop legacy tombstones and tokens tables
totp secrets and recovery codes for admins
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS totp (username TEXT PRIMARY KEY, secret TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_step INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, FOREIGN KEY (username) REFERENCES users(username) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recovery_codes (username TEXT NOT NULL, code_hash TEXT NOT NULL, used_at DATETIME, PRIMARY KEY (username, code_hash), FOREIGN KEY (username) REFERENCES users(username) ON DELETE CASCADE)

migrations.description: per-user storage quota (bytes, 0 = unlimited) and used bytes; existing users get 1 GB
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_quota (username TEXT PRIMARY KEY, quota_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000000000 CHECK(quota_bytes >= 0), used_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, FOREIGN KEY (username) REFERENCES users(username) ON DELETE CASCADE)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO user_quota (username) SELECT username FROM users

migrations.description: dead properties (RFC 4918 section 4) per owner and path; path is relative to the owner's data root
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dead_props (username TEXT NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL, namespace TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, lang TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, size INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (username, path, namespace, name), FOREIGN KEY (username) REFERENCES users(username) ON DELETE CASCADE) WITHOUT ROWID
